actions.name: reconnect_device
actions.description: Reconnect the native Quad Cortex transport after explicit confirmation.

actions.name: reset_device_session
actions.description: Reset and re-synchronize the native Quad Cortex communication session after explicit confirmation.

actions.name: disconnect_device
actions.description: Close the native Quad Cortex transport after explicit confirmation.

actions.name: get_current_preset
actions.description: Read the authoritative current preset, scene, tempo and Grid state.

actions.name: get_state_events
actions.description: Read native state frames after a sequence cursor.

actions.name: get_tempo_clock
actions.description: Read the most recent native metronome beat, bar and tick state.

actions.name: get_block_details
actions.description: Read live parameters for one occupied Grid block, splitter, or mixer.

actions.name: get_lane_control_details
actions.description: Read the Input Gate or Lane Output parameters attached to a signal row.

actions.name: list_models
actions.description: Find installed block models and their numeric IDs.

actions.name: list_presets
actions.description: List presets in a setlist, optionally refreshing the device index.

actions.name: list_preset_folders
actions.description: List preset folders and setlists, optionally refreshing the device index.

actions.name: list_preset_slots
actions.description: List preset destinations and their occupancy before a persistent write.

actions.name: get_master_volume
actions.description: Read the authoritative master output volume.

actions.name: get_device_identity
actions.description: Read the connected Quad Cortex serial number, firmware version, type and custom name.

actions.name: get_inhibited_modules
actions.description: Read the authoritative Global Gate and Global EQ inhibition state.

actions.name: get_tuner_settings
actions.description: Read the tuner input, mute preference, and reference pitch without changing or engaging the tuner.

actions.name: get_preset_screenshot
actions.description: Read the PNG thumbnail stored for a preset.

actions.name: capture_screen
actions.description: Capture the current Quad Cortex touchscreen as a PNG image.

actions.name: preview_parameter
actions.description: Preview a block, splitter, or mixer parameter value without waiting for device verification.

actions.name: preview_lane_control_parameter
actions.description: Preview an Input Gate or Lane Output parameter without waiting for device verification.

actions.name: create_device_backup
actions.description: Create a complete local device backup after explicit confirmation.

actions.name: set_device_name
actions.description: Change the Quad Cortex custom name after explicit confirmation.

actions.name: undo_device
actions.description: Undo the most recent device edit after explicit confirmation.

actions.name: redo_device
actions.description: Redo the most recently undone device edit after explicit confirmation.

actions.name: tap_screen
actions.description: Tap an exact touchscreen pixel after reviewing a fresh screen capture and explicitly confirming the action.

actions.name: select_scene
actions.description: Immediately select a performance scene, numbered 0 through {maxScene}.

actions.name: copy_scene
actions.description: Copy or swap two scenes in the current preset and verify the resulting scene state.

actions.name: set_scene_label
actions.description: Set or clear the label of one scene in the current preset.

actions.name: set_scene_color
actions.description: Set the display color of one scene in the current preset.

actions.name: press_footswitch
actions.description: Press a physical Quad Cortex footswitch by its stable hardware index.

actions.name: tap_tempo
actions.description: Tap the dedicated Quad Cortex tempo control through its official MIDI command.

actions.name: navigate_bank
actions.description: Immediately navigate one performance bank down (-1) or up (1).

actions.name: show_tuner
actions.description: Show or hide the tuner.

actions.name: show_gig_view
actions.description: Show or hide Gig View.

actions.name: select_mode_slot
actions.description: Select device-configured performance Mode Slot A, B, or C.

actions.name: set_master_volume
actions.description: Set master output volume after explicit user confirmation and stale-value validation.

actions.name: recall_preset
actions.description: Immediately recall a preset by setlist key and position.

actions.name: reload_preset
actions.description: Discard unsaved edits and reload the active preset after explicit host confirmation.

actions.name: set_tempo
actions.description: Immediately set performance tempo from {minTempo} through {maxTempo} BPM.

actions.name: set_bypass
actions.description: Immediately enable or bypass one Grid block and verify device readback.

actions.name: set_parameter
actions.description: Immediately set a writable block, splitter, or mixer parameter and verify it.

actions.name: set_parameter_scene_mode
actions.description: Enable or disable per-scene storage for a block, splitter, or mixer parameter and verify device readback.

actions.name: set_parameter_expression
actions.description: Assign EXP 1 or EXP 2 to a block, splitter, or mixer parameter, or clear it with pedal 0, preserving the requested heel and toe range.

actions.name: set_lane_control_parameter
actions.description: Set an Input Gate or Lane Output parameter with stale-value and preset guards.

actions.name: set_lane_control_scene_mode
actions.description: Enable or disable per-scene storage for an Input Gate or Lane Output parameter and verify readback.

actions.name: set_expression_bypass
actions.description: Assign EXP 1 or EXP 2 to a block bypass with the QC switch mode, inversion, delay and latch-emulation settings.

actions.name: move_block
actions.description: Move an existing Grid block to an empty column in the same row with model and preset guards.

actions.name: add_block
actions.description: Add an installed model to an empty Grid cell and verify the resulting block.

actions.name: remove_block
actions.description: Remove a Grid block after validating its model and active preset.

actions.name: set_block_footswitch
actions.description: Assign or clear a Grid block footswitch with preset, model and assignment guards.

actions.name: set_stomp_momentary
actions.description: Set a single-block STOMP footswitch to momentary or latching behavior and verify device readback.

actions.name: set_stomp_label
actions.description: Set the visible label of a STOMP footswitch using the device's correct single- or multi-assignment storage.

actions.name: set_midi_out
actions.description: Replace up to 12 MIDI Out messages for a footswitch or expression-pedal source in the current preset.

actions.name: set_preset_load_midi_out
actions.description: Replace the MIDI Out messages sent when the current preset loads.

actions.name: set_chain_input
actions.description: Change a signal-row input after validating the current route and preset.

actions.name: set_chain_output
actions.description: Change a signal-row output after validating the current route and preset.

actions.name: set_chain_split
actions.description: Set or clear a signal-row split and rejoin with complete stale-route guards.

actions.name: save_preset_as
actions.description: Save the current preset to a reviewed device slot with explicit overwrite confirmation.

actions.name: rename_current_preset
actions.description: Rename the active stored preset after explicit confirmation.

actions.name: copy_preset
actions.description: Copy a device preset to a reviewed destination with explicit overwrite confirmation.

actions.name: get_general_settings
actions.description: Read the QC Device Settings and System settings without changing them.

actions.name: get_io_settings
actions.description: Read complete input, output, headphone, USB, MIDI, expression-pedal, connection, and output-pairing settings.

actions.name: set_input_port
actions.description: Change one or more settings for a QC input. Each supplied field is sent in its own hardware update; input gain is expressed safely in dB.

actions.name: set_output_port
actions.description: Change level, ground lift, or mute for one QC output. Every supplied field is sent in a separate hardware update.

actions.name: set_usb_port
actions.description: Change USB level, headphone source, or dry/wet routing using normalized device values and separate hardware updates.

actions.name: set_midi_thru
actions.description: Enable or disable the QC MIDI Thru setting after explicit confirmation.

actions.name: set_output_pairing
actions.description: Pair or unpair output couples. Null leaves that output couple unchanged.

actions.name: get_global_eq
actions.description: Read Global EQ bypass state and all 28 normalized parameters.

actions.name: set_global_eq_bypassed
actions.description: Enable or bypass the global EQ after explicit confirmation.

actions.name: set_global_eq_band
actions.description: Update one Global EQ band with sparse normalized controls after explicit confirmation.

actions.name: set_global_eq_output
actions.description: Update Global EQ output level and output-pair assignments after explicit confirmation.

actions.name: get_mode_cycle
actions.description: Read the configured footswitch modes in cycle order.

actions.name: set_mode_cycle
actions.description: Replace the ordered footswitch mode cycle after explicit confirmation.

actions.name: get_looper_status
actions.description: Read the complete Looper X transport and progress state when a looper is present.

actions.name: control_looper
actions.description: Control Looper X through its documented MIDI CC interface.

actions.name: list_recents
actions.description: List recently used presets with authoritative folder metadata.

actions.name: list_favorites
actions.description: List favorite presets using request correlation even when the reply omits its favorites flag.

actions.name: set_favorite
actions.description: Add or remove one exact device library entry from Favorites after explicit confirmation.

actions.name: list_pinned_models
actions.description: List model IDs and capture keys pinned in the device model browser.

actions.name: set_model_pinned
actions.description: Pin or unpin one model ID after explicit confirmation.

actions.name: list_captures
actions.description: List loadable Neural Captures with their content keys and names.

actions.name: load_capture
actions.description: Place or retarget a Neural Capture block using a device library key and name.

actions.name: list_irs
actions.description: List loadable Impulse Responses from the whole library or a selected device folder.

actions.name: load_ir
actions.description: Place or retarget an IR Loader and set one of its two IR slots by key and name.

actions.name: create_setlist
actions.description: Create a user setlist after explicit confirmation.

actions.name: delete_setlist
actions.description: Delete a named user setlist and its contents after explicit confirmation.

actions.name: duplicate_setlist
actions.description: Create a user setlist and copy its source presets through the shared recall-and-save workflow after explicit confirmation.

actions.name: delete_preset
actions.description: Delete a named preset from a writable user setlist after explicit confirmation.

actions.name: move_preset
actions.description: Move a named preset to another slot in its user setlist after explicit confirmation.

actions.name: set_general_integer
actions.description: Change one validated integer Device Setting after explicit confirmation. Hold timing uses its wire index 0 through 5.

actions.name: set_general_toggle
actions.description: Change one validated on/off Device Setting after explicit confirmation.

actions.name: set_scene_bypass_behavior
actions.description: Change the global scene block-bypass persistence behavior after explicit confirmation.

actions.name: set_master_volume_assignment
actions.description: Replace all four Master Volume output assignments atomically after explicit confirmation.

actions.name: set_global_bypass
actions.description: Replace all Cab and IR global-bypass row flags atomically after explicit confirmation.
